semantics.function: q = ~(a ^ b ^ c ^ d); even parity
semantics.timing: Output follows current inputs after combinational settling; no clock cycles or explicit delay. Waveform times are stimulus times.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization required; 0000 produces 1

numeric.arithmetic: Bitwise XOR and complement; no numeric addition, rounding, truncation, saturation, or overflow

verification.oracle: Literal truth table transcribed from the original waveform, indexed by {a,b,c,d}; independent of the RTL parity expression
verification.coverage: All 16 binary combinations forward and reverse, repeated 0000 holding checks, and all 256 ordered transitions
verification.comparison: Case inequality against literal expected bit after 1 ns settling
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite external timeouts and testbench watchdog
verification.scope: Development simulation only; no official evaluation or synthesis

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X or Z inputs is not specified; development acceptance covers binary inputs only.
